list.title: Event requests
list.description: Events that are planned, in progress or done, with their briefs and status.
list.emptyNone: Requests you file or follow appear here.
list.lateTodos: {count, plural, one {# late to-do} other {# late to-dos}}
list.dialogDescription: Start a draft. The brief, date and the rest can follow on the request page.

page.readOnly: You can view this request but not change it.

actions.cancelDescription: The request is closed for good. Say why, so everyone who follows it knows.
actions.fallbackGate: The event week can start once the fallback plan is complete. Still open: {scenarios}.

details.title: Details
details.name: Title
details.docsHelp: An https link to the event's documents.

brief.label: Brief
brief.help: Describe the event in Markdown. Every saved change becomes a new version.
brief.unchanged: Nothing changed, so no new version was saved.
brief.conflict: The brief changed in the meantime. Reload to see the latest version, then merge your edits.
brief.readOnly: The brief can no longer be edited.

image.hint: Choose a file or drop it here. PNG, JPEG, WEBP or GIF, up to {size} MiB.
image.tooLarge: The image may be at most {size} MiB.
image.wrongType: Only PNG, JPEG, WEBP and GIF images are accepted.

banner.title: Event banner
banner.help: The image shown with the event announcement.

questions.waiting: The team is waiting for your answers: {count, plural, one {# open question} other {# open questions}}.
questions.emptyText: If the team needs to know more, its questions appear here.
questions.notSure: Not sure, let the team decide
questions.invalid: This answer does not fit the question. Check it.

accept.title: Accept this request
accept.description: Turn the request into a project the team builds, or link it to a project that already exists.
accept.deadlineValue: The project deadline is the end of the event: {date}.
accept.createHelp: The project gets the event board, three phases and one system with the brief as its first spec draft.
accept.noProjects: You are not an editor of any project.
accept.linkHelp: The brief is not written into the spec of an existing system.

progress.title: Build progress
progress.label: Build progress of the event
progress.archived: The project is archived. These are the last counts.

link.title: Project
link.deletedHelp: The project built for this request no longer exists.

discordEvent.noToken: No Discord event: bot token not set.
discordEvent.noGuild: No Discord event: server ID not set.
discordEvent.notYet: No Discord event yet. It is created with the announcement.
discordEvent.noDocs: Add an event docs link: the Discord event description needs it.

briefBanner.title: Brief changed since spec v{version}
briefBanner.changes: {count, plural, one {# brief version} other {# brief versions}} since the spec was written.
briefBanner.notApplied: This system was linked to an existing spec; the brief was not applied to it.
briefBanner.diffTitle: Changes from brief version {from} to version {to}

updateFromBrief.title: Update from brief
updateFromBrief.description: Paste this into your own agent. It reads the brief changes and updates the spec, plan and tasks.
updateFromBrief.explain: The app runs nothing itself: your agent compares the changed brief with the spec, then adds or changes steps and tasks without touching finished work.
updateFromBrief.copyFailed: Copying failed. Select the command and copy it by hand.

fallback.help: What do we do when something goes wrong? The three required scenarios need an answer to "what we do" and "who decides" before the event week can start.
fallback.playerMessageHelp: Prepared in German. It may contain placeholders such as '{event}' and '{start_date}'.

prep.help: Prepare the event step by step. Dates follow the event date until you set one by hand.
prep.empty: No to-dos yet. They are created when the request is accepted.

eventDay.title: Event day
eventDay.description: Everything the team needs while the event runs.
eventDay.notLive: The event week has not started, so the checklist and check-in are closed.
eventDay.readOnly: You can read the checklist but not tick it.

settings.title: Event settings
settings.description: Channels, message styles and templates for the event posts.
settings.readOnly: You can read these settings but not change them.
settings.secretsAdmin: Values are stored encrypted and are never shown again. Only the last four characters stay visible.
settings.secretsManager: Only admins can change secrets. You see whether each is set and its last four characters.
settings.publicWebhookHelp: Posts the announcement, reminder and the event messages to the public channel.
settings.teamWebhookHelp: Posts the team message to the team channel.
settings.postAsHelp: The name the posts are signed with.
settings.pingRoleIdHelp: The numeric id of the role an announcement may ping. Leave empty for none.
settings.guildIdHelp: The numeric id of the Discord server. Leave empty if you do not use scheduled events.
settings.timeZoneHelp: Event dates, times and prep to-do due dates use this zone.
settings.rulebookUrlHelp: An https link. Shown as the rules in the details message.
settings.styleHelp: Describes the tone for the copy prompt. Empty uses the default text shown here.

template.title: Title
template.linesHelp: One fact per line, at most 10 lines.
template.unknown: {name} is not a known placeholder here.
template.previewNote: Shown with a sample event. Nothing is sent.

messages.help: Write the messages for the event and post each with one click. Nothing is posted on its own.
messages.pingUnset: No ping role is set in Event settings yet.
messages.previewStale: Save the draft to update this preview.
messages.stall: If the post stalls, check the channel before resuming.
messages.reasonWebhook: An admin has to set the {target} webhook in Event settings first.
messages.reasonStatus: Messages can be posted once the request is accepted.
messages.confirmBody: This posts to the {target}. It cannot be undone except by deleting the messages.
messages.readOnly: You can view the messages but not change them.
messages.editNote: {count, plural, one {# message} other {# messages}} will be updated. Edits never ping.
messages.deleteBody: {count, plural, one {# message} other {# messages}} will be removed from the {target}. A Discord event stays.
messages.testHelp: Sends the saved draft to the staff channel only. It never pings and creates no event.
messages.testReasonStaff: An admin has to set the staff test webhook in Event settings first.
messages.testOk: {count, plural, one {# test message} other {# test messages}} sent to the staff channel
messages.testTimeout: The test send has not answered yet. Try again in a moment.

disaster.title: Disaster message
disaster.postBody: This posts the message below to the public channel right now.
disaster.resolveBody: The disaster message stays as it is. The message below is posted as a new message.
disaster.posted: The disaster message is being posted
disaster.reasonRights: Only the event team can post a disaster message, and only in the event week.
disaster.reasonWebhook: An admin has to set the public webhook in Event settings first.
disaster.deleteBody: This removes the disaster message from the public channel. Use it when a post is stuck.

prompts.title: Copy prompts
prompts.description: Texts for the event messages, ready to paste into a chat assistant.
prompts.instruction: Paste this into any chat assistant, then paste the text it writes back below.
prompts.copyFailed: Copying failed. The text is selected, copy it by hand.
